title: Finite étale Artinian residue lift without flatness
statement: Let D and S be commutative local Artinian rings, with a local D-algebra structure on S. For every element b of the residue field of S separable over the residue field of D, there exist a finite étale local Artinian D-algebra D' and a local ring map g':D'→S factoring the structure map D→S, and d in D' whose image in the residue field of S is b. If D:Type u and S:Type v, D' can be taken in Type (max u v z) for any z. Flatness of D→S is not required.

source.place: Tag 07FI, finite étale extension and henselian factorization paragraphs

proof.text: Apply the capture theorem to obtain D' with all required properties except Artinianness. Install its CommRing, Algebra, local, local-hom, Etale, and finite-module instances; IsArtinianRing.of_finite D D' then supplies the missing Artinian instance.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_artinian_residue_lift_core
    (D : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing D] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing D] [IsArtinianRing D] [IsLocalRing S] [IsArtinianRing S]
    [Algebra D S] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap D S)]
    (b : IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)
    (hb : IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField D) b) :
    ∃ (D' : Type (max u v z)) (_ : CommRing D') (_ : Algebra D D') (g' : D' →+* S),
      IsLocalRing D' ∧ IsArtinianRing D' ∧
      IsLocalHom (algebraMap D D') ∧ IsLocalHom g' ∧
      Etale D D' ∧ Module.Finite D D' ∧
      g'.comp (algebraMap D D') = algebraMap D S ∧
      ∃ d : D', IsLocalRing.residue S (g' d) = b
